subject: POC success criteria & KPIs — next steps
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@atlaspayments.com>

- We need target KPIs to evaluate: latency p50/p95, throughput (reqs/sec), cost/token, and quality/accuracy metrics for our payments routing prompts.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Nora Lee <nora@atlaspayments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — POC goals

Hi Samir — great to talk yesterday, thanks for the clear asks. I put together a short POC plan and proposed KPIs below. Attaching a one-pager and sample eval scripts.

POC summary (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (prep, 2–3 business days): account setup, model selection, baseline telemetry. Ownership: Jordan (sales) + Marissa (solutions engineer).
- Week 1 (integration): integrate Redwood SDK/REST, ingest 5k sample prompts, basic routing. Ownership: Atlas eng + Redwood SE.
- Week 2 (scale & tuning): run load tests (throughput/latency), enable KV caching and batching. Ownership: Greenwood (typo) — kidding — Redwood infra team + Atlas infra.
- Week 3 (quality eval & cost tuning): run eval sets, compute quality/accuracy metrics, test quantization/config changes to meet cost targets.
- Week 4 (wrap & decision): recap, handoff, and recommendations.

Proposed KPIs (we recommend measuring these across dev/staging traffic and a short production-like replay):
- Latency: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 250ms for 8k context prompts (measured end-to-end from client SDK).
- Throughput: sustain 150 reqs/sec with 10 token avg response (scale target can be adjusted).
- Cost: target <= $0.003/token (model+infra) for production config; POC expected to be higher due to limited batching.
- Quality: >92% accuracy on the routing decision set (we'll use your labeled sample of ~1k prompts). We'll report precision/recall and examples of misroutes.

Security/compliance: attaching our SOC 2 summary & data handling note. For the POC we recommend encrypted uploads, isolated test data, and configured log retention (30 days) — Marissa will own the evidence bundle.

Next steps:
1) Samir/Nora confirm sample dataset (location & size) and POC start date.
2) Atlas provides a contact for infra access and any IP allowlist.
3) Redwood sends a short SOW (no-cost POC) and the Drive folder with scripts + redwood-poc-plan.pdf attached.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for planning. Want to propose Wed 22 May 10:30am PT — does that work?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Nora Lee <nora@atlaspayments.com>

Subject: Re: Quick sync — POC goals

Thanks Jordan — Wed 10:30 PT works for me. Confirming a couple items before the call:

- Dataset: we'll share a 1k labeled routing sample and a 4k unlabeled sample (S3 link).
- Security: we'll need SOC2 Type II evidence and a short note about log retention and encryption at rest.
- Evaluation metrics: for quality, can you include an example thresholding strategy (confidence score cutoffs) and how you compute precision/recall on the labeled set?

Appreciate the clear KPIs — we'll review internally and try to reduce their breadth for the POC if needed. See you on the call.

-Nora
Sr. Product Manager, Atlas Payments

Hi Samir / Nora — following up from today's planning call (notes below). Attaching the redwood-poc-plan.pdf and sample-eval-scripts.zip to the Drive link in the thread.

Call recap (concise):
- Start date: Monday 27 May 2029
- Atlas to provide: S3 link to labeled/unlabeled datasets, infra contact for allowlist, and service account for SDK access.
- Redwood to provide: test environment, pre-configured model variants (default + quantized), eval scripts, and SOC2 evidence.

Agreed success criteria (finalized for POC):
- Latency: p50 < 100ms, p95 < 275ms (relaxed from the initial ask for test stability).
- Throughput: target 100 reqs/sec sustained during a 30-minute load window.
- Cost: POC target <= $0.005/token (acknowledging limited batching).
- Quality: 90%+ routing accuracy on the labeled set; we'll review failure cases weekly.

Ownership:
- Redwood SE (Marissa): integration, telemetry dashboards, and SOC2 evidence bundle.
- Jordan: program management and escalation.
- Atlas infra (Samir): allowlist + dataset access.

Immediate next steps (action items):
- Samir: share dataset + infra contact (by EOD Thu).
- Jordan: send POC SOW and calendar invite for kickoff (sent).
- Marissa: upload eval scripts and baseline run results to the shared Drive (by Mon 27 May).

Attachments referenced: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (one-pager), sample-eval-scripts.zip (Python scripts + metrics).

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth run.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
